017package org.apache.juneau.console.views;
018
019import static java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
021
022import java.io.*;
023import java.nio.*;
024import java.nio.channels.*;
025import java.nio.file.*;
026import java.nio.file.attribute.*;
027import java.util.*;
028import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;
029import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;
030import java.util.concurrent.locks.*;
031import java.util.zip.*;
032
033/**
034 * A sparse, bounded index from 1-based line numbers to byte offsets in one UTF-8 text file that may keep growing
035 * while it is read.
036 *
037 * <p>
038 * The index keeps one offset per {@code stride} lines. When {@code maxEntries} offsets are held, the stride doubles
039 * and every other entry is dropped, so memory stays at most {@code maxEntries} longs whatever the file size. A
040 * {@link #seek(long)} scans at most {@code stride - 1} lines from the nearest entry. {@link #refresh()} reads only
041 * bytes appended since the previous call.
042 *
043 * <p>
044 * The index resets (new {@link Snapshot#epoch() epoch}) when the file key changes (replaced or rotated by rename),
045 * when the file shrinks below the indexed size (truncated), or when its first bytes change (rewritten in place).
046 * A copy-truncate that regrows past the old indexed size with byte-identical first 64 bytes before the next
047 * {@code refresh()} cannot be detected; rotate logs by rename instead.
048 *
049 * <p>
050 * Thread-safe. Keep one instance per log file and share it across requests; otherwise every request re-scans the
051 * file from byte 0.
052 *
053 * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
054 * <p class='bjava'>
055 *    FileLineIndex <jv>index</jv> = FileLineIndex.<jsm>of</jsm>(<jv>logFile</jv>);
056 *    FileLineIndex.Snapshot <jv>s</jv> = <jv>index</jv>.refresh();
057 *    <jk>long</jk> <jv>offset</jv> = <jv>index</jv>.seek(<jv>s</jv>.indexedLines());
058 * </p>
059 *
060 * @since 10.0.0
061 */
062public final class FileLineIndex {
063
064   /** Default lines per index entry. */
065   public static final int DEFAULT_STRIDE = 1000;
066
067   /** Default maximum number of index entries. */
068   public static final int DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES = 4096;
069
070   /** Size of the head fingerprint in bytes. */
071   public static final int FINGERPRINT_BYTES = 64;
072
073   static final int BLOCK_BYTES = 65_536;
074
075   private static final long EPOCH_SPACE = 2_176_782_336L; // 36^6
076   private static final byte[] EMPTY = {};
077
078   /**
079    * The result of a {@link #refresh()}.
080    *
081    * @param epoch Six base36 characters identifying this file generation.
082    * @param indexedBytes Offset just past the last {@code \n}.
083    * @param indexedLines Number of complete lines in {@code [0, indexedBytes)}.
084    * @param fileSize File size at the time of the refresh.
085    */
086   public record Snapshot(String epoch, long indexedBytes, long indexedLines, long fileSize) {}
087
088   /**
089    * Builder for {@link FileLineIndex}.
090    */
091   public static final class Builder {
092      private final Path file;
093      private int stride = DEFAULT_STRIDE;
094      private int maxEntries = DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES;
095
096      Builder(Path file) {
097         this.file = Objects.requireNonNull(file, "file");
098      }
099
100      /**
101       * Sets the initial lines per index entry.
102       *
103       * @param value At least 1.
104       * @return This object.
105       */
106      public Builder stride(int value) {
107         if (value < 1)
108            throw iaex("FileLineIndex stride must be >= 1; got %s.", value);
109         stride = value;
110         return this;
111      }
112
113      /**
114       * Sets the maximum number of index entries.
115       *
116       * @param value At least 2.
117       * @return This object.
118       */
119      public Builder maxEntries(int value) {
120         if (value < 2)
121            throw iaex("FileLineIndex maxEntries must be >= 2; got %s.", value);
122         maxEntries = value;
123         return this;
124      }
125
126      /**
127       * Builds the index. No I/O happens until {@link FileLineIndex#refresh()}.
128       *
129       * @return A new index.
130       */
131      public FileLineIndex build() {
132         return new FileLineIndex(this);
133      }
134   }
135
136   private final Path file;
137   private final int initialStride;
138   private final int maxEntries;
139   private final ReentrantLock lock = new ReentrantLock();
140   private final AtomicReference<Snapshot> snapshot = new AtomicReference<>();
141   private final AtomicReference<String> earlyEpoch = new AtomicReference<>();
142
143   // Guarded by lock.
144   private Object fileKey;
145   private byte[] head = EMPTY;
146   private long indexedBytes;
147   private long indexedLines;
148   private long scannedBytes;
149   private long[] entries;
150   private int count;
151   private int stride;
152
153   private FileLineIndex(Builder b) {
154      file = b.file;
155      initialStride = b.stride;
156      maxEntries = b.maxEntries;
157      reset(null);
158      snapshot.set(new Snapshot(epoch(null, EMPTY), 0, 0, 0));
159   }
160
161   /**
162    * Creates an index with the default stride and entry cap.
163    *
164    * @param file The file. Supplied by the application, never taken from a request.
165    * @return A new index.
166    */
167   public static FileLineIndex of(Path file) {
168      return create(file).build();
169   }
170
171   /**
172    * Creates a builder.
173    *
174    * @param file The file. Supplied by the application, never taken from a request.
175    * @return A new builder.
176    */
177   public static Builder create(Path file) {
178      return new Builder(file);
179   }
180
181   /**
182    * The indexed file.
183    *
184    * @return The path given to the builder.
185    */
186   public Path file() {
187      return file;
188   }
189
190   /**
191    * The result of the last {@link #refresh()}, without I/O.
192    *
193    * @return The snapshot.
194    */
195   public Snapshot snapshot() {
196      return snapshot.get();
197   }
198
199   /**
200    * Stats the file and indexes only the bytes appended since the previous call.
201    *
202    * @return The new snapshot. A missing file gives an empty snapshot.
203    * @throws IOException If reading fails.
204    */
205   public Snapshot refresh() throws IOException {
206      lock.lock();
207      try {
208         BasicFileAttributes attrs;
209         try {
210            attrs = Files.readAttributes(file, BasicFileAttributes.class, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
211            if (attrs.isSymbolicLink())
212               return missing();
213         } catch (NoSuchFileException e) {
214            return missing();
215         }
216         var key = attrs.fileKey();
217         var size = attrs.size();
218         try (var ch = FileChannel.open(file, StandardOpenOption.READ, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
219            if (neq(key, fileKey) || size < indexedBytes || headChanged(ch, size))
220               reset(key);
221            readHead(ch, size);
222            scan(ch, size);
223         } catch (NoSuchFileException e) {
224            return missing();
225         }
226         return publish(size);
227      } finally {
228         lock.unlock();
229      }
230   }
231
232   /**
233    * Returns the byte offset of the start of line {@code n}.
234    *
235    * @param n The 1-based line number.
236    * @return The offset; {@code indexedBytes} for {@code n = indexedLines + 1}; {@code -1} outside
237    *    {@code [1, indexedLines + 1]} or when the file no longer has that line.
238    * @throws IOException If reading fails.
239    */
240   public long seek(long n) throws IOException {
241      lock.lock();
242      try {
243         if (n < 1 || n > indexedLines + 1)
244            return -1;
245         var i = (int)Math.min((n - 1) / stride, count - 1L);
246         var line = 1 + (long)i * stride;
247         var pos = entries[i];
248         if (line == n)
249            return pos;
250         try (var ch = FileChannel.open(file, StandardOpenOption.READ, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
251            var buf = ByteBuffer.allocate(BLOCK_BYTES);
252            while (pos < indexedBytes) {
253               buf.clear();
254               if (indexedBytes - pos < BLOCK_BYTES)
255                  buf.limit((int)(indexedBytes - pos));
256               var r = ch.read(buf, pos);
257               if (r <= 0)
258                  return -1;
259               for (var k = 0; k < r; k++)
260                  if (buf.get(k) == '\n' && ++line == n)
261                     return pos + k + 1;
262               pos += r;
263            }
264         } catch (NoSuchFileException e) {
265            return -1;
266         }
267         return -1;
268      } finally {
269         lock.unlock();
270      }
271   }
272
273   /**
274    * Whether a token epoch belongs to the current file generation.
275    *
276    * <p>
277    * Accepts the current epoch and, when this instance published one, the generation's epoch from before the
278    * 64-byte head fingerprint existed.
279    *
280    * @param epoch The epoch from a token.
281    * @return <jk>true</jk> if tokens with this epoch are still valid.
282    */
283   boolean acceptsEpoch(String epoch) {
284      return epoch != null && (eq(epoch, snapshot.get().epoch()) || eq(epoch, earlyEpoch.get()));
285   }
286
287   /** Current stride (grows when the entry cap is reached). */
288   int stride() {
289      lock.lock();
290      try {
291         return stride;
292      } finally {
293         lock.unlock();
294      }
295   }
296
297   /** Current number of index entries. */
298   int entryCount() {
299      lock.lock();
300      try {
301         return count;
302      } finally {
303         lock.unlock();
304      }
305   }
306
307   private Snapshot missing() {
308      if (fileKey != null || head.length > 0 || indexedBytes > 0 || scannedBytes > 0)
309         reset(null);
310      return publish(0);
311   }
312
313   private void reset(Object key) {
314      fileKey = key;
315      head = EMPTY;
316      earlyEpoch.set(null);
317      indexedBytes = 0;
318      indexedLines = 0;
319      scannedBytes = 0;
320      stride = initialStride;
321      entries = new long[Math.min(16, maxEntries)];
322      entries[0] = 0;
323      count = 1;
324   }
325
326   private boolean headChanged(FileChannel ch, long size) throws IOException {
327      if (head.length == 0)
328         return false;
329      if (size < head.length)
330         return true;
331      return ! Arrays.equals(head, read(ch, head.length));
332   }
333
334   private void readHead(FileChannel ch, long size) throws IOException {
335      if (head.length >= FINGERPRINT_BYTES || size <= head.length)
336         return;
337      head = read(ch, (int)Math.min(FINGERPRINT_BYTES, size));
338   }
339
340   private static byte[] read(FileChannel ch, int len) throws IOException {
341      var buf = ByteBuffer.allocate(len);
342      while (buf.hasRemaining()) {
343         if (ch.read(buf, buf.position()) <= 0)
344            break;
345      }
346      return Arrays.copyOf(buf.array(), buf.position());
347   }
348
349   private void scan(FileChannel ch, long size) throws IOException {
350      var buf = ByteBuffer.allocate(BLOCK_BYTES);
351      var pos = scannedBytes;
352      while (pos < size) {
353         buf.clear();
354         if (size - pos < BLOCK_BYTES)
355            buf.limit((int)(size - pos));
356         var r = ch.read(buf, pos);
357         if (r <= 0)
358            break;
359         for (var k = 0; k < r; k++) {
360            if (buf.get(k) == '\n') {
361               indexedLines++;
362               indexedBytes = pos + k + 1;
363               recordLine(indexedLines + 1, indexedBytes);
364            }
365         }
366         pos += r;
367      }
368      scannedBytes = pos;
369   }
370
371   private void recordLine(long line, long offset) {
372      if ((line - 1) % stride != 0)
373         return;
374      if (count == maxEntries) {
375         var kept = 0;
376         for (var i = 0; i < count; i += 2)
377            entries[kept++] = entries[i];
378         count = kept;
379         stride *= 2;
380         if ((line - 1) % stride != 0)
381            return;
382      }
383      if (count == entries.length)
384         entries = Arrays.copyOf(entries, Math.min(maxEntries, entries.length * 2));
385      entries[count++] = offset;
386   }
387
388   private Snapshot publish(long size) {
389      var full = head.length >= FINGERPRINT_BYTES;
390      var epoch = epoch(fileKey, full ? head : EMPTY);
391      if (! full)
392         earlyEpoch.set(epoch);
393      var s = new Snapshot(epoch, indexedBytes, indexedLines, size);
394      snapshot.set(s);
395      return s;
396   }
397
398   private static String epoch(Object key, byte[] fingerprint) {
399      var crc = new CRC32();
400      crc.update(String.valueOf(key).getBytes(UTF_8));
401      crc.update(0);
402      crc.update(fingerprint);
403      var s = Long.toString(crc.getValue() % EPOCH_SPACE, 36);
404      return "0".repeat(6 - s.length()) + s;
405   }
406}
